corrections.note: The r7 compiled-guest evidence lists only VestaDoubleAssign. r8/r9 add complete execution verification and independently program-derived keys on reload; early per-shard proof checks do not establish those properties.
The r18 findings describe the window-major improvement recorded as r20 in the cycle ledger. One change, not two savings.
Decomposition profiling/barrier and carry claims were corrected. Use r35/r41 conclusions rather than treating raw instrumented regions as clean costs.
Pallas shortening evolved to the centered r58 construction; r60 corrects the width-selection explanation.
r49 seeded a short basis under a full-domain cache key. r52 fixes the API contract; current code keeps distinct prefix/full-domain caches.
Early window sweeps mixed specialized and dynamic recoders. Later fair sweeps and inventory qualify earlier conclusions.
r53 trace accounting had duplicate dependencies, absent-chip and padding/shape interpretation errors. Use corrected r54 and v3 r71/r72 results.
First borrowed-Vesta implementations regressed; the outlined r78 form was retained.

The r83 reproducer intentionally triggers IPA point capacity grew before the final MSM. This is a performance-contract failure, not a cryptographic verifier rejection; r82 already passed native verification.
r97 identity-copy hypothesis was not established and was not retained. r111 optimizes known-finite first insertions, a different operation.
Cross-host proof times do not isolate the SP1 version. r124 matched-host repetitions found wall-time differences within spread.
Round numbering is not execution order. r125 GPU validation corrects r126 CPU sweep recommendation: batching width 8 does not justify shipping; default stays 1 in that external experiment.
Only manifest/scripts found at capture. This is an evidence snapshot, not monitoring of the ongoing source workspace.
